ResearchTabDef.label: Foundation
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Develop Foundation communications, containment chambers, personnel equipment and response weapons. Only one research project can be active at a time.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Foundation contact
ResearchProjectDef.description: Establish a secure communications channel with the Foundation and prepare an access terminal for official contact.

ResearchProjectDef.label: basic containment post
ResearchProjectDef.description: Mark a steel holding position for the first recovered anomaly before setting up concrete production.

ResearchProjectDef.label: primary materials
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop a local concrete production process and the standard Foundation wall needed for basic containment construction.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Foundation production
ResearchProjectDef.description: Set up the central Foundation workshop bench. Dedicated armory and laboratory modules require their own research.

ResearchProjectDef.label: containment surveillance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop powered cameras, staffed monitoring consoles and autonomous chamber sensors.

ResearchProjectDef.label: reinforced structures
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop reinforced walls, armored observation glass, armored doors, automatic blast shutters, hermetic access and room decontamination for more demanding chambers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Farnsworth-Lipson fusor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a powered fusor that links to the Foundation laboratory and supports high-energy equipment production.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Foundation special armament
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop high-energy suppression systems, advanced turrets and POR-7 equipment for containment teams.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Foundation medical protocols
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop controlled amnestics, mnestic protection and emergency field hemostatics for personnel exposed to anomalous hazards.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Foundation personnel clothing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Prepare researcher coats and class D uniforms for assigned personnel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Foundation firearms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Adapt Foundation carbines, light machine guns and shotguns for local manufacture.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Foundation tactical armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture assault vests and the heavier Nu-7 armor and helmet.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Foundation capture weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture tranquilizer rifles and nonlethal containment net launchers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: MTF powered armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the XPA-M6 exosuit and its sealed helmet after applying one Foundation techprint. Crafting also requires a powered fusor linked through a laboratory module.

ResearchProjectDef.label: anomalous item stations
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study safe holding and handling methods for anomalous items. Individual designs arrive with their recovery assignments.

ResearchProjectDef.label: SCP-106 containment chamber
ResearchProjectDef.description: The SCP-106 recovery assignment reveals a dedicated chamber design. Research it before building the powered chamber.

ResearchProjectDef.label: SCP-882 seawater reservoir
ResearchProjectDef.description: The SCP-882 recovery assignment reveals a full-strength seawater reservoir and inspection procedure.

ResearchProjectDef.label: SCP-682 acid containment
ResearchProjectDef.description: The SCP-682 transfer assignment reveals a powered hydrochloric acid chamber for the subdued creature.

ResearchProjectDef.label: SCP-127 storage case
ResearchProjectDef.description: The SCP-127 recovery assignment provides the plans for its regenerative storage case.

ResearchProjectDef.label: SCP-262 containment hanger
ResearchProjectDef.description: Successfully defending the SCP-354 perimeter releases plans for a dedicated SCP-262 holding stand.

ResearchProjectDef.label: SCP-093 mirror frame
ResearchProjectDef.description: The collector estate assignment reveals how to build a controlled mirror frame for the recovered disc.
